email.body1:
Shreena, saw Treasure Data became Treasure AI and launched the agentic experience platform with AI Studio.

A reposition like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the Americas team can act on, and signal-to-action latency is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR turns a buying signal into a researched, personalized, followed-up touch with zero human time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a personalized signal play for Treasure AI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Shreena, quick follow-up for Treasure AI.

Most sales-ops teams sit on strong intent data but the manual research-write-log loop means signals decay before a rep acts. Tightening that into reviewed, auto-logged outreach is usually where measurable lift hides.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three changes I'd make. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Shreena, last bit of proof for Treasure AI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Treasure AI's reply rate likely compares to other data-platform teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an Americas RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to Treasure AI either way.
